standing: PROPOSED description-only D2b3c successor; exact independent design-unit review and root assent required

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-3a (D2b plan r3 as amendments A1 and A2 amend it): the TS2 codec's receive side. Each worker frame takes the envelope, its closed schema, LD-D2B-15's contextual admission against the immutable DispatchContext (the echoes, LD-D2B-18's HelloAck exact echo with A2's descriptor fields, the stage correlation and batch counters, the candidate and anchor laws, the terminals' coverage) with every commitment recomputed over the received bytes, then the T2O table step, before conversion into the generated carriers; the TS2 depth bounds. Library only, with no caller.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D accepted D2b-3a and D2b-3c TS2 receive side: envelope, closed carrier/product schema, contextual admission and received-byte commitments precede T2O and generated conversion. FA-2 exact census-token variants, Plan request/null joins, complete census CBOR/count/order/extent bounds, source-closed linear signature-token validation, parallel typed census and typed over-bound event are admitted; symbol-key settlement remains H's. Separate frame/relation depth closures; no production caller, invented TS2 aggregate bound or qualification.

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-3a: an admitted TS2 payload converted by hand-written code into the generated carriers, after its closed check; serde never reads wire bytes, and the generator's open-JSON members are built as GeneratedJson.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D accepted D2b-3a/3c admitted TS2 payload conversion into generated carriers after its closed check, including the parallel complete/over-bound typed symbol census. Original received payload bytes remain available for H; serde never reads wire bytes and open-JSON members use GeneratedJson. No H fact admission or qualification.

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-3b: the TS2 participant D3a's supervisor drives (LD-D3A-3): at most one read or write per call, each host slot written only when T2O admits it, the context and request joined at construction, progress and span boundaries from admitted transitions only, admitted FactBatch payloads spooled into the one terminal output and discarded with an inadmissible settlement, and the participant's own failures reported as HostFault, never provider-protocol.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D accepted D2b-3b/3c TS2 participant driven by D3a: one non-blocking read/write per call, T2O-gated host slots, exact context/request joins, admitted progress/span boundaries, host failures as HostFault. Raw admitted FactBatch, Coverage, Complete, Unavailable and BudgetExhausted payloads spool in admission order and move into the one terminal output or are discarded on inadmissible settlement. Individual frame bounds apply; accepted LD-D2B-8 leaves the aggregate TS2 spool uncapped. No H admission or qualification.

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-3b (D2b plan r3 as amendments A1 and A2 amend it): the TS2 codec's send side. The seven host frame families built from the admitted Plan's values (Ts2Plan) and each checked against its closed schema before spawn; LD-D2B-9's canonical send schedule (REQUEST-WIRE-ACCOUNTING: every slot's exact envelope payload and digest, the greedy chunks in closed form, the reserved maximal Cancel, the entry and frame bounds refused through the carriers' route); and the HOST-SEND-SCHEDULE sender, realizing each frame independently and comparing it with its slot before it becomes sent state, with LD-D2B-7's Cancel law, every failure ending the transcript. Library only, with no caller.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D accepted D2b-3b/3c TS2 send side: Plan-derived closed host payloads and canonical REQUEST-WIRE-ACCOUNTING/HOST-SEND-SCHEDULE slots, greedy chunk sizing, reserved Cancel and exact realization checks. Negotiated FA-2 Analyze carries the Plan-provided owed census/enumeratorClosure or null, with symbol-key Dempty request commitments verified against the Plan. Every sender failure ends the transcript; C4 owns Plan admission and H owns returned symbol settlement. Library only, no production caller or qualification.

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-3b tests: the builders against their sources and their host-invariant refusals, the canonical schedule and its bounds through the route, the sender's exact slot consumption with every divergence and snapshot failure ending the transcript, LD-D2B-7's Cancel law, the table's gate, and the participant from Hello to DONE with its spool, discard, boundaries, faults and host pipe ends.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D accepted D2b-3b TS2 builder/schedule/sender/participant controls, including exact slot divergence, cancellation, faults, spans and terminal output; D2b-3c census-aware context/request controls and module entry points for the separately inventoried census and historical TS2-owned replay tests. Accepted native-owner startup controls retained. No claim of352 TS2 replay executions, production wiring or qualification.

passageOverrides.before: M3-D unit D2b-3a tests: a lawful TS2 session, each step's refusals before the table and before publication, the HelloAck echo, the stage correlation and batch counters, the candidate and anchor laws, the terminals' coverage with piecewise admission, every commitment recomputed over received bytes with the provenance control, and the depth bounds recomputed from the documents.
passageOverrides.after: M3-D accepted D2b-3a TS2 receive controls for lawful sessions and pre-table envelope/schema/context refusals, exact descriptor echoes, stage/batch/candidate/anchor laws, terminal coverage, received-byte commitments and depth closure. D2b-3c admits negotiated census contexts while refusing an owed census without its token and malformed descriptor contexts. Existing no-token refusal controls retained; no production caller or qualification.
